incident-bot: [PAGER] high error rate detected on /v1/generate (5xx spike) | error-rate: 14% over 5m | region: eu-west-1
Nina (oncall): got it. Investigating now. I'll grab logs and check recent deploy.
Nina (oncall): short summary to start — 5xxs across model-serving pool, latency also up. No config changes in last 30m that I'm aware of.
Luis (oncall): @Nina are we seeing specific model variants? can you paste the top 3 failing model ids?
Nina (oncall): top errors by model: redwood-7b-v2-int8 (45%), open-16k (30%), redwood-inf-1 (15%). Full tail in logs.
Nina (oncall): running `kubectl logs -l app=runtime --since=10m | grep ERROR | head -n 50` now.
Corey (sre): I can start a canary rollback to last known-good container if needed. We should consider routing traffic to dedicated fallback nodes.
Nina (oncall): rolling back a deploy would affect traffic, let's confirm cause first. I'm seeing increased 502s mentioning `kv-cache` failures and OOM-ish GC entries.
Samir (prodops): copying status page draft below — please edit. If we push, we should publish within 15m.
Samir (prodops): ```STATUS PAGE DRAFT
Incident: Degraded inference responses in EU region
Scope: Some customers may see increased error rates (5xx) or higher latency for text generation calls to /v1/generate in eu-west-1.
Time window: 2026-11-12T15:20Z - ongoing
Impact: Partial — not all requests affected.
Mitigation: On-call team investigating; temporary routing to fallback pool for impacted tenants in progress.
Next update: in 15 minutes.```
Elena (support): I'm prepping a customer-facing note for affected tenants. Draft below — please flag edits.
Elena (support): ```CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION DRAFT
Hi — we are investigating higher error rates affecting text generation in EU. Our engineers are actively mitigating and routing traffic to fallback capacity. We do not expect data loss. We will follow up with an impact summary and any applicable SLA credit information. Apologies for the disruption.```
Nina (oncall): thanks — small change to include timeframe and a contact link. Update: `Time window: started ~2026-11-12T15:20Z` and add support@redwood.ai.
Samir (prodops): publishing status now. I'll include the mitigation note about fallback routing.
incident-bot: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-11-12-eu-inference-degraded
Luis (oncall): @Marta Billing tagging you — if this becomes a partial outage >30m we may need to evaluate SLA credit eligibility and notify billing for potential refunds/credits.
Marta Billing: on it. please flag affected customer list and estimated downtime per tenant. I'll correlate against committed SLA tiers (99.9/99.95) and MRR impact.
Nina (oncall): attaching quick export of affected tenants and counts (pasted snippet):
```
tenant-a.example.com, failed_requests: 320, window: 00:18:23
enterprise-beta, failed_requests: 120, window: 00:12:10
acme-inc, failed_requests: 3, window: 00:00:45
```
Luis (oncall): looks like tenant-a is the big one. Do we have an automated billing script to compute credits?
Marta Billing: yes, I have a calculator but need confirmation of exact outage window per customer and whether the SLA conditions (total request failure or availability) meet the credit policy. I can run it quickly once we have final windows.
Corey (sre): mitigation path update: scaled up fallback pool + disabled kv-cache on a subset of nodes to prevent OOM. Errors dropped to ~1.8% in the last 5m.
Nina (oncall): agree — observed drop. Keeping watch. If numbers hold for 10m we can start rollback is not required.
Elena (support): I'll send a targeted customer update to tenant-a with the same boilerplate and a dedicated support link. Draft below for approval:
```
Hi Tenant A team — we're aware of failed inference requests affecting your account between 15:20Z and 15:38Z today. Engineers applied a mitigation and requests are returning to normal. We're evaluating credit eligibility and will follow up with a detailed post-incident summary. Contact support@redwood.ai for immediate questions.
```
Samir (prodops): please don't promise exact credit amounts in initial message; say "evaluating credit eligibility" only.
Elena (support): updated. sending customer note now.
Marta Billing: ran the credit estimator against the current windows — tenant-a meets threshold for a pro-rata credit under our 99.9 SLA. Estimated credit = one day of service prorated (calc attached). I'll open an internal billing ticket and coordinate the refund.
Nina (oncall): good. I'll prepare a short internal postmortem skeleton with timeline, root-cause hypotheses, and actions.
Samir (prodops): for internal comms — here's a concise template for execs:
```
Executive update:
- What happened: transient kv-cache failures caused higher error rates for a subset of customers in EU.
- Impact: partial service degradation, highest for tenant-a; mitigations reduced errors within ~18 minutes.
- Customer-facing: status page + targeted tenant notifications sent.
- Next steps: postmortem + permanent fix (disable problematic cache path, add memory limits, broaden fallback capacity).
```
Corey (sre): also creating followup tasks: monitor mem pressure, add canary that exercises kv-cache, and run failover drills.
Luis (oncall): handing off — @Nina I'm stepping off incident in 10m, please own the post-incident followups.
Nina (oncall): taking over. leaving a short handoff note: mitigation stable, monitoring for recurrence, billing informed, support notified.
incident-bot: Incident severity lowered to S2 — recovery in progress.
Marta Billing: internal billing ticket created: BILL-2026-874 — assigned to me. Will update when credits scheduled.
Elena (support): customer tenant-a replied asking for ETA on credit posting — suggested reply: "We are finalizing calculations and will post the credit by EOD tomorrow. We'll confirm when complete." Approve?
Marta Billing: approve that wording.
Nina (oncall): closing loop: final numbers look stable. I'll submit incident timeline to the incident repo and mark this thread for postmortem triage.
Samir (prodops): thanks all — great run. Please link the incident page/pm in the postmortem so billing and support can attach artifacts.
Elena (support): sent tenant-a update.
Marta Billing: will post billing adjustments after finance approval; ETA 24-48h.
Nina (oncall): last check-in — no regressions in last 20m. marking as monitored.
Corey (sre): adding the remediation PR to link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482
Nina (oncall): thread closing in 30m; move to postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
